description: Shared, language-neutral Nostr known-answer test vectors. This file is the canonical spine for the Nostr key/crypto family (nostr-nsec-seedphrase, nostr-crypto-utils, browser plugin, ...). All public keys are 32-byte x-only per BIP-340. Copy this file verbatim into sibling projects; do not embed language- or library-specific assertions here.

alice.note: BIP-340 test vector: smallest valid secret key (1). x-only pubkey equals the secp256k1 generator point G x-coordinate.

nip06_seedphrase.description: Canonical NIP-06 vector (standard BIP32 derivation m/44'/1237'/account'/0/0 from the BIP39 seed). This is the interoperable standard used across the Nostr ecosystem.
nip06_seedphrase.mnemonic: leader monkey parrot ring guide accident before fringe cannon center peace inside
nip06_seedphrase.compat_note: nostr-nsec-seedphrase v0.8.0 does NOT implement standard NIP-06 derivation; it derives the private key as sha256(bip39-entropy). It therefore does not reproduce this vector. See library_seedphrase for a vector this library's seedPhraseToKeyPair actually produces.

library_seedphrase.description: nostr-nsec-seedphrase-specific derivation: privateKey = sha256(bip39-entropy). Provided so the seed-phrase path has a real known-answer for THIS library. NOT interoperable with standard NIP-06.
library_seedphrase.mnemonic: test test test test test test test test test test test junk

nip19.description: NIP-19 bech32 round-trip vectors. npub encodes a 32-byte x-only pubkey; nsec encodes a 32-byte private key; note encodes a 32-byte event id.

nip01_events.description: NIP-01 event structure. The event id (sha256 of the serialized [0,pubkey,created_at,kind,tags,content]) is deterministic and can be asserted; BIP-340 schnorr signatures are non-deterministic (aux randomness) so sig is verified by round-trip, not by fixed value.
